{"consolidated_memory":"CORRUPTED SCAFFOLD IN cli/commands/init.py - TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

File: cli/commands/init.py (developer tooling)
Common symptom across both: corrupted scaffold in the init command, manifesting as a generated tree missing one file
Reproduction condition (both cases): init into a directory that already has a lockfile
Stack: Python
Covering test: tests/cli/test_init.py

INCIDENT 1: [2026-01-15]
- Trigger: jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: added the composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR: #2404 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1
- Measured outcome: throughput rose 15 percent, to 928 requests per second

INCIDENT 2: [2026-03-07]
- Trigger: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: the config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR: #4066 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-3
- Measured outcome: the nightly rollup matched the source counts for 81 days running

These represent distinct database and configuration issues both producing the same symptom in the init scaffold generation."}
